name: SSCE Internal registration fee
conditions: Per school-based candidate. Includes four-figure mathematical tables and waterproof certificate jacket/folder. Stamp duty, service and Remita charges also apply; amount non-refundable.
requirements: School-based SS 3 candidates only; private candidates are excluded.; Valid NIN is compulsory.; Candidate biodata, passport photograph in school uniform, subjects and 10-finger biometric data.; School portal access/claim and State Coordinator activation; signed validation documents as applicable.
deadlines: 19 Jan–25 May 2026 normal; 26–29 May 2026 late (where applicable)
source_wording: ₦30,000.00 only per candidate inclusive of Four-Figure Mathematical Tables and Waterproof Certificate Jacket/Folder.
official_process: NECO school portal, TSA/Remita; State Coordinator for activation/validation
evidence_notes: One official local PDF; no current replacement identified in repository.

name: E-photo album

deadlines: 19 Jan–25 May 2026 normal; 26–29 May 2026 late (where applicable)
source_wording: A pair of the e-Photo Album ... costs Two Thousand Seven Hundred Naira (N2,700) only per pair.

evidence_notes: One official local PDF; no current replacement identified in repository.

source_wording: The syllabus for NECO SSCE is available at the cost of Two Thousand Naira (N2,000.00) only per copy.

name: Unviable centre fee
conditions: School registering fewer than 20 candidates is unviable; fee applies if it wishes to hold the examination at its school. Initial instalment payment should cover at least 20 candidates to avoid this surcharge.
deadlines: 19 Jan–25 May 2026 normal; 26–29 May 2026 late (where applicable)
source_wording: Unviable Centre Fee is N70,000.00; any school registering less than twenty candidates is deemed unviable.

name: Late registration penalty
conditions: Additional per-candidate penalty during the expressly stated late registration window, 26–29 May 2026.
deadlines: 19 Jan–25 May 2026 normal; 26–29 May 2026 late (where applicable)
source_wording: Late Registration attracts a Penalty of additional N5,000.00 per candidate.

name: Non-validation penalty
conditions: Per candidate irrespective of the nature of non-validation; applies to specified correction requests after online upload. Passport-photo changes only before registration closes; other specified corrections may be entertained before examination.
deadlines: 19 Jan–25 May 2026 normal; 26–29 May 2026 late (where applicable)
